column4: Prism refuses a class in a method body ("unexpected class definition in method body", prism diagnostic.c:141) before typedump answers, and the walk sees only the method's subtree
Prism refuses a module in a method body ("unexpected module definition in method body", prism diagnostic.c:280), as for ClassNode
Prism has no IndexNode kind (prism config.yml); `a[i]` is a CallNode named `[]`, the call entry, and this key is inherited from the parser the table was written for
Prism refuses a constant assignment in a method body ("dynamic constant assignment", prism diagnostic.c:383); a top-level one is outside the walked method
Prism places a RescueNode only under BeginNode#rescue_clause or another RescueNode#subsequent (prism config.yml), and the walk meets the BeginNode first
Prism places an EnsureNode only under BeginNode#ensure_clause (prism config.yml), and the walk meets the BeginNode first
